question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Following the credo ‘Together we stand, divided we fall’, the factory workers left their work and stepped out of the factory _________ to hold a protest rally against the higher authorities.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**en-masse**" means collectively or all together. (सामूहिक रूप से)
 
• The phrase "en-masse" fits the context of workers collectively stepping out of the factory to hold a protest rally.
 
• Other options like "**impasse**", "**ex-facto**", and "**en-route**" do not fit the sentence appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Following the credo ‘Together we stand, divided we fall’, the factory workers left their work and stepped out of the factory en-masse__ to hold a protest rally against the higher authorities.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Impasse (गतिरोध)**: means a situation where no progress is possible.
 
• **Ex-facto (पूर्व तथ्य)**: means from the fact or retrospective.
 
• **En-route (मार्ग में)**: means on the way.

```
